questions.prompt: Today's goal, per Snellman, is mainly to:
choices: A Fill out unit-circle values with tricks—not blind memorization of everything.
B Memorize 48 unrelated facts with no structure.

questions.prompt: θ = π/6 on the unit circle refers to:
choices: A The central angle of π/6 from the positive x-axis.

questions.prompt: Reflecting a first-quadrant point can produce angles such as:

choices: A Subtracting multiples of 2π (periodicity) to a coterminal standard angle.
C Replacing cos with tan always.
D Setting it to zero automatically.

questions.prompt: Solving trig equations on the circle often yields:
choices: A Families of solutions spaced by 2π (integer multiples).
B Exactly one real number ever.
